purpose: the agent-under-test is the constant across all lanes — architecture is the variable, model is the constant (README: The demonstration)

primary.rationale: public hosted id on the NVIDIA NIM catalog — anyone with an NVIDIA API key (free credits on signup) can reproduce the runs; no local stack required

judge.rationale: the blind judge for answer agreement (F4, ISC-19): a different model family from the nemotron agent-under-test, so no run is graded by its own family; flash tier keeps a full 180-run suite cheap; the same NVIDIA key reproduces it. Switched from deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash mid-F4 (2026-10-27): that NIM endpoint stalled server-side — trivial one-token prompts hung for minutes while other models answered — so the judge moved to another same-tier catalog model; every score artifact names the model that actually judged it.

local_alternative.status_at_pin: vMLX serve stopped — start it to use this pin locally
local_alternative.rationale: fully local reproduction anchor: same Mac, zero cost, no network

note: the runner pins the agent-under-test and the blind judge explicitly on every invocation; switching models is an explicit, recorded change to this file
